message.content:
A classic lasagna typically includes:

| Category | Common Ingredients |
|----------|--------------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef or Italian sausage, onion, garlic, crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce, tomato paste, oregano, basil, salt, pepper, a splash of red wine (optional) |
| **Cheese Layer** | Ricotta or cottage cheese, shredded mozzarella, grated Parmesan |
| **Vegetable Layer** (optional) | Sautéed spinach, zucchini, mushrooms, bell peppers, or eggplant |
| **Binding** | Egg (mixed into ricotta for extra richness) |
| **Seasoning** | Salt, pepper, dried oregano, dried basil, a pinch of nutmeg (for the béchamel) |
| **Béchamel Sauce** (optional) | Butter, all‑purpose flour, milk, nutmeg, salt, pepper |
| **Topping** | Extra shredded mozzarella and grated Parmesan |

Feel free to adjust quantities based on how many servings you need and your taste preferences!
